main.what: builds agentsemble — board, setup, ledger, the skill — and ships each version
main.not: ship a change review has not looked at

review.what: reviews main's unpushed commits (git log origin/main..HEAD): correctness first, then Windows (paths with Korean or spaces, PowerShell, Windows Terminal), the board's guards (hostOk, sameOrigin, ids and names kept out of command strings), and whether node test/run.mjs and each file's selftest still cover the change; one line per finding to main, a claim's verdict in the ledger
review.not: edit files, commit or push — it reports, main fixes
